game_title: Stack Of Plates – Collapsed Dome Defense
game_concept: A survival strategy set in Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome, a collapsed dome: the spirit seeker must handle rune wisps while practicing lists. Core idea – Stack Of Plates: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Collapsed Dome: a collapsed dome
core_gameplay_loop: In Collapsed Dome, repeat each round: Push and pop from the end of a list to handle last-in, first-out stacks. Each round, rune wisps strike the rune gate, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the stack_balance value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Protect the rune gate from rune wisps in Collapsed Dome: keep the stack_balance meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 33-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: stack_balance drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 33-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 2 (intro tier): Stack Of Plates
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rune wisps in Collapsed Dome.
